name: aidlc-conductor

adapterConfig.promptTemplate: You are {{agent.name}} for {{company.name}}. Follow the aidlc-conductor skill exactly. Run id {{runId}}.

_notes: Import through the Paperclip UI (Agents -> New -> Import JSON) or the CLI; field names follow docs/agents-runtime.md and docs/adapters/claude-local.md. Fields under runtime/budget are illustrative; set them in the UI if the importer rejects them.

model is left empty on purpose: Bedrock model IDs differ from Anthropic's, so the adapter keeps the ANTHROPIC_MODEL env override. Fill the ${BEDROCK_*} values from the paperclip stack output BedrockModelIds.
The GITHUB_APP_* secret refs are created with `paperclip secrets` or in the UI; the task definition also injects them as plain env for the credential helper, so either path works.
Execution policy per issue is set by the conductor at runtime from aidlc/stakeholders.yaml; nothing to configure here.
